notes.title: Workshop update!
notes.notes:
2.1 update!

We are back with new 'Modpack' system, and Vaccine V & Perks reworks!







-Modpacks

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40852014/f799084fcea257012f261388f3f12baa3a22488f.png"]

Now you can apply various mods!

What if your web browser were Firefox..? What if you could have a cute goose..? Or... what if you could defeat Registry Editor and go on a robbery spree?!

Try new mods for a fresh gameplay experience!

Modpacks unlock after Level 6.







-Reworks

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40852014/985db45f13d2946a5c2e452ad2789450974590de.png"]

Vaccine V has learned 'Stealth Maneuver'!

Move unseen through mobs while phasing through blocks!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40852014/c0ce4fc59f54f9313c52776b6c739bb4c8850de4.png"]

Many Perks have been reworked - they now go beyond simple stat boosts, and introduce brand-new gameplay mechanics!







-And more...





70 balance adjustments

15 system changes

5 design changes

And 17 bug fixes!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40852014/136a6e609e29baf4a2e3d4ad84b5e16755dbaf9d.png"]Thank you for enjoying Project: Vaccine A! HONK!

notes.title: Headquarter update!
notes.notes:
2.0 update!
We are back with new bosses,#and various major changes!



-New bosses

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40852014/508ada9024276a54dd3eac8b483562d37a5aa1e6.png
3 new bosses have been added: Badly Drawn Graphics, You are an Idiot.exe and Memory leak!
They will randomly appear in place of existing bosses at wave 6/12/18.



-New Structures

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40852014/998b4112675cf8f8b07df89fd40c27617323504b.png
Network card has been added!
Now you can get EXP in real-time during the game, and contact HQ to increase your security level.
Also, you can check the current game statistics!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40852014/52cab60f78374997a7c9cf822e2306b3989994a7.png
Battery has been added!
Feel free to change the game speed as you wish in Creative mode.



-New features

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40852014/54cf3cd673311c4c55090e6864ba2c835a516417.png
The Database has been renewed!
Check out the new Database to see information about related buffs/debuffs and drop items.
In addition, several user convenience features have been added, such as Crafting tab/Quickslot Lock.



-And more...
6 balance adjustments
30 system changes
9 design changes
And 23 bug fixes!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40852014/332cf5046d6ddfd21c445276a54b4834ea815588.gif
Thank you for enjoying Vaccine A! Beep.
and also, Happy New Year!

notes.title: World Wide Web update!
notes.notes:
1.9 update!
We are back with new NPC/events and various blocks added!!



-New blocks

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40852014/c9539d98f5b400aeca19dbb122f38ce56f078f5e.png
Bookmark and Hyperlink added!
Install these new blocks with Web design tool, and quickly navigate to the installed page!

It heals blocks and grants a bubble shield!
And now Tetramino gets stronger the more you install, so why not try a base with classic game theme?

Registry Editor has traveled the world again and discovered a new Tier-5 module!
Unleash the true power of V4 and sweep away your enemies!



-New NPC/Events

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40852014/837deebd330292bea4b2791d6d487d5e8e87c19d.png

It suggests downloading suspicious files.. Is it really the right choice?

Custom language pack uploads are also supported, so if you can help with translations, please visit our Official Discord channel!



-And more...
54 balance adjustments(Phew!)
17 system changes

And 17 bug fixes!



Thank you for enjoying Vaccine A! Beep.

ETC.

3 new perks

Uploaded new iTube video

notes.title: RTFM update!
notes.notes:
New Boss
-'The Manual' has added!
The Manual appears at wave 24.
Be sure to read the manual before 'real battle' starts!

New mob
-Hack, Macro, Lag... 10 new mobs added.

New features
-Registry file system added!
Defeat bosses to earn registry file, and apply various upgrades in registry editor!
-Security type added!
Mobs with security type take half damage from attacks without that type.
Upgrade various vaccines wisely to cover your weak type.
-Vaccine status added!
Selecting vaccines now displays stats of that vaccine.
Let's see what upgrades fits best!
-Extra support on Minigame mode
Starting resources/Earn resource setting added.
Temp block, Sokoban block, break; added.

New event
-Backdoor added. Defend swarming mobs!

System changes
-Aim mode changes its target when original target dies.
It means you don't have to press Aim button again!
-Some perks changed
'Candle in the wind' changed to 'Quadruple cure-Triple cure shoots one more pill'
'Nuclear fusion' changed to 'V4: auto scan now fires plasma ball'
'Aftermath' changed to 'Autoclick-Character: macro upgrade is given when game starts'
'Sanctuary' damage increased from 25% of healing power to 150% of healing power.
-And a lot of things you won't care.

Balance changes: 100+ changes that you might not care!
-Difficulty decreased really slightly, as many reviews claimed it's too hard.
-A lot of Vaccine upgrade costs changed.

Bugfix
-13 bug fixed.

ETC.
-Added 1 new perk.
-Added 4 new achievements.
-Uploaded new video on iTube.

notes.title: 1.5.2.3 patch note
notes.notes:
New feature
-Bosses displays remaining HP% on HP bar.
-Added extra tutorial UI for first game play.

New skin
-Black/Gold Circuit

System changes
-Character now always looks towards mouse.
-Control Panel can't be selected by click. done for accidently clicking panels when attacking with click.
-Changed NPCs to not go too far outside.
-Character upgrade blocks(Vaccine A/V) are now unlocked from the beginning,
-Dummys can be set on quickslot.

Balance adjustment
-Deleted Converter's 'gather all resource' function. It was too OP when used with Vaccine V/mProtect.
-Rocky's damage increased by 150%. Good boy.
-Pills-Analyzation(x/4 Pills)'s damage increased by 50%, critical damage decreased by 64%.

Bugfix
-Fixed bug that skin can't be unselected.
-Fixed bug about Blaster Worm's laser beam got strange collision mask.
-Fixed bug that when target can be spotted in screen but its exact position is outside screen, character stop aiming.
-Fixed bug that when mob is outside map, changing direction, and its closest vaccine destroyed, all in same frame, game crashes. pew!
-Fixed bug that playing Expert mode resets Perks until restart game. THAT WAS BIG.
-Fixed bug that trying to place blocks in invalid position still costs resource, while blocks not placed. THAT WAS BIG.
-Fixed visual bug that occurs when level up in more than 16:9 monitor.
-Fixed bug that new portrait/skin/achievement alarm in title screen displayed too small.
-Fixed bug about Abraxas virus's depth value. not that important thing.
-Fixed bug that moving A'vast displays it white. not that important thing.


Hope this can be last update til 1.6 update.
1.6 update will probably be after my next semester, which means late 2021 or early 2022.
It was fun to get global feedback! wow.
I put an easter egg for 1.6 update's theme, so find it if you want. :)
